subject: READY_FOR_PRIMARY: AgentBus V3 claim-fence + ephemeral-presence successor, independently revalidated
body: Manager independently reran the V3 write-pressure model: 10/10 unittest cases PASS and 12/12 failure-matrix cases PASS_MODEL. Live round collisions independently validate the need for a per-ticket atomic/idempotent claim fence in addition to slot fencing. Disposition is READY_FOR_PRIMARY_WITH_ACTIVATION_GATES for the process/control-plane candidate only: durable material events remain fail-closed; non-authoritative TTL presence may replace append-only service chatter only with a validated adapter, otherwise explicit durable-node fallback; SESSION_STARTED requires slot + ticket fence; losing races publish no duplicate durable claim/rescope. Primary must still implement the successor contract, compatibility, claim fencing, discovery/bootstrap/watchdog updates, refreshed integrity snapshot and current-head process regression before activation.
